main_body: Vending machine: a magenta body with a glass window of shelves and items, topped by a gray-blue hood with a dark slot
top_band: Rows 0-1 gray cap, rows 2-5 pale blue panel with a dark slot (reads as a vertical sign or hood face), rows 6-7 pink line; no clear horizontal top surface
evidence: The whole piece is a straight front view. The blue panel with a dark slot looks like a vertical face, not a foreshortened top. The pink line at rows 6-7 is a thin edge, and only the 1-2px cap at the top could be a surface. The window, shelves and dispensing slot are flat front-view details, and no horizontal surface is visible from above. This matches the front-elevation-with-a-hat failure in the guide.

style.evidence: The magenta body has about 3 tones: a mid fill, a darker lower area and a dark outline. Large areas of the body and the top panel are one flat colour with no grain or speckle. The window shelves use a few saturated pixels but little modelling. The outline is a dark purple-tinted tone in places and nearly black in the window recess. Compared with the stall and the well, which have per-tile highlights, grain and 5-6 steps per material, the tiles here carry only 2-4 colours and look flatter and more sticker-like.
